'''K2-8''' was a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] active in the aftermath of the [[war against Zakuul]]. In [[3630 BBY]] it was brought to [[Iokath]], where it provided assistance during the the [[War on Iokath]], a conflict between the three major superpowers in [[The galaxy/Legends|the Galaxy]]: the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], and the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
K2-8 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a vendor on Iokath for both Imperial and Republic players.
